entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jon Mirena Bitor Castañares Larreategui was a Spanish politician and economist. He was known for being a strong supporter of Basque nationalism. He served as mayor of Bilbao from 1979 to 1983. He died in Bilbao at the age of 90.
